correctness.rationale: Direct planar concatenation gives the exact rank criterion. Retained outer cups and caps force cross-support separation for distinct commuting idempotents; distant generators commute in the converse direction. Weighted spaced-interval packing yields the recurrence, generating function, exact pair counts, largest clique size and extremal multiplicities. Standalone union–find exhaustive computations for n=2..12 corroborate all finite specializations; infinite assertion uses the general proof, not extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The claimed compatibility criterion and all-degree commuting-clique polynomial are not given by East–Gray Lemma 9.8 (which supplies the already-known single-idempotent classification), its ideal-generating-set enumerations, or the reviewed algorithmic enumerations of individual idempotents by Dolinka et al. Searches of published research and relevant local historical claims found no direct equivalent or stronger implication. Risk remains from an unlocated independent-set/interval-packing formulation or a general commutative-subband theorem; no absolute uniqueness claim is made.
residual_risks: An unlocated old presentation of compatible Jones idempotents as a weighted independent-set/interval-packing model may imply the whole theorem.

value.rationale: Pairwise commuting idempotents are natural generators of commutative bands and their clique polynomial records a full hierarchy of compatibility invariants. Previous exact one-element idempotent enumerations leave these compatibility questions open. The finding gives an all-n classification with a three-step weighted recurrence, precise ordered-pair counts, and parity-sensitive extremal multiplicities; it is an infinite-family structural refinement rather than an arbitrary finite table.
